name: DsButton
extends: Fallthrough attributes (Vue `$attrs`) are applied to `<button>`, including `disabled`, `aria-*`, and listeners such as `@click`. Vue automatically merges `class` with the base classes. This field is required: it documents which attributes are forwarded and where `class` is applied. For components with `inheritAttrs: false`, specify the inner element receiving the attributes (or "— no fallthrough attributes").
description: Template example component. Demonstrates the expected entry structure; the generator replaces this array completely with the target design system's inventory. `status` is required on every entry: verified = read from code or measured; derived = inferred from a deterministic source (CSS bundle, Figma variables); estimated = LLM judgment (screenshots, prose specs).
